name: Soybean Leaf Images for Pest Damage Recognition
description: The Soybean Leaf Images for Pest Damage Recognition dataset is an agricultural computer vision collection containing 6,410 real-world images of soybean leaves (Glycine max) photographed in commercial farming environments across southern Brazil. The dataset is categorized into three classes: caterpillar defoliation damage (3,309 images), Diabrotica speciosa beetle feeding damage (2,205 images), and healthy foliage without pest injury (896 images). Captured under unconstrained field conditions (wind, sunlight, clouds, and varied shadows) using handheld smartphones and aerial drones, images were standardized to 500x500 pixels. The dataset was designed to train convolutional neural networks for pest monitoring, automated defoliation calculation, and precision pest management.
